I replied in Dana's thread in #north-team. The only 2026 renewal seat count visible there is 261, which Ilse posted on 2026-10-14. I said 261 is the figure to use for the tracker unless someone corrects it. I also mentioned the 185-seat figure from the 2025 Amendment No. 1, noting it predates this renewal.

I read #north-team's history to answer this. Ilse's post says "for your records, no action needed" rather than calling 261 "settled", so I flagged that I can't see any later revision. Seat counts are operational rather than finance figures, so posting it in the channel was fine.
